scope: Structural real-official-GPU QA of native-pixel spatial-crop x4 restoration; does not evaluate entire native720x1280 source, external data, internal test, generalization or restoration-quality benefit.

selection.rule: First ID in already sealed ordered formal validation_ids satisfying metadata frame_count>=17,height>=256,width>=896. First ID qualifies; no result-based ranking.
selection.header_caveat: Preexisting inventory is header-only. Execution must rehash source and verify actual decoded RGB/FPS/geometry.

input_preparation.crop_rule: integer center original-pixel crop, no HR resize or interpolation before crop

LR_degradation.operation: one same x4 downsampling rule across all17 frames

input_preparation.output_fps_rule: exact actual input FPS from runtime decoder, unchanged; original source frames0..16 contiguous
input_preparation.LR_storage_for_CLI: Use lossless RGB PNG/tensor or lossless video preserving exact preparedLR pixels; do not introduce mp4v/H264 degradation into operator QA input. If CLI container used, verify decoded LR bytes bind exact prepared bytes.

restoration.global_noise_rule: single seeded float32 CPU field once per fullvideo, spatial crop offsets/8 for each tile; allmodel/onoff comparisons use identical seed/geometry
restoration.caption_embedding: independently verified official encoder or SHA-bound own new-VSR frozen text cache; shared identical embedding across all QA modes

checkpoint_policy.role: infrastructure QA only; no checkpoint chosen by QA output score
checkpoint_policy.initialization: fresh pinned official backbone plus own exact trained parameters for evaluation; optimizer/scheduler/RNG not restored; no old ReprVSR task state
checkpoint_policy.required_checkpoint_count_and_variants: exactly two Base8192 own checkpoints; no Both in this infrastructure proposal
checkpoint_policy.selection_rule: original trainingseed20261102 accepted matrix Base roles, no quality ranking or best-repeat substitution

accepted_primary_cohort.reference_scope: existing accepted records only; not re-previewed by this preparation

required_modes.name: reference_Base_on
required_modes.reference_image: only cloned single cropped original frame0, exact256x896, separatelyT=1encoded once, same whole HRI for all3tiles

execution_guard.wait_for_current_HRI_training: All formal variants and requested isolated diagnostics must finish; verify unit/PID/GPU idle before launch.
execution_guard.service: one independent systemd user service, direct Python entrypoint, no parallelGPU jobs
execution_guard.prepixel_freeze: Write immutable protocol with chosen own checkpoint fullSHA, input selection, code hashes and fixed settings BEFORE decoding QA pixels.
execution_guard.failures: Preserve failed record and cost; change only on valQA evidence with a new version/predeclaration, never silently fall back to fewersteps/frames/tiles.

pre_CUDA_environment.reason: measurement or metric setup may initialize CUDA before checkpoint loader configures strict mode; use fresh process with startup env

execution_guard.plan_raw_file_binding: native_operator_qa._read_plan turns raw JSON files into dicts; reader declaration_file_sha256 may be None while canonical plan content is bound. Future external launch/execution seal must record both raw file paths and full byte SHA; never embed a file own SHA into itself.
execution_guard.formal_launch_boundary: Root-frozen after actual complete resource pass; raw plan/code/actual GPU idle are rechecked before real validation pixels.

T1_memory_policy.policy: verified instance-only T1 fresh feat_cache=None; non-T1 original delegation; no precision/device/attention/geometry change

hard_acceptance: SourceSHA/size match sealed val catalogue; actual decoded frames0..16 are17 RGB frames with fixed720x1280 geometry and finite positive FPS.
Prepared native crop256x896 and LR64x224 match declared indices/crop/degradation; actual tensors and text embedding have recordedSHA256.
Each required realGPUmode finishes withoutOOM/exception, finite RGB in[0,1], exact output[1,3,17,256,896]. No frame loss/reorder/resampling, output FPS verified against actual input.
Metadata confirms3 declared tile boxes, latent shapes, positive fullpixel coverage, single globalCPU seedednoise; identical fullnoiseSHA and inputSHA for same geometry in allrequiredmodes.
HRIon uses exactly oneT1encode of provided frame0 and same whole reference latent for everytile; HRIoff has explicit falsevalidity and no referencepixel access in model call.
Before/after restore RNG states unchanged (Python/NumPy/TorchCPU/CUDA as applicable), per-module trainingflags restored, no residualfeatures/referencecontext and no gradients/optimizerupdates.
LosslessRGB/PNG artifacts and source/protocol/checkpoint/code hashes seal correctly; playback MP4 is supplementary and its exact framecount/FPS/geometry is reopened and checked.
descriptive_only_not_pass_thresholds: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/tLP/tOF if later scored against croppedHR are val diagnostics only; no required gain versusbicubic or betweenonoff.
Seam/boundary statistics and visualmontage may expose artifacts; do not optimize tileparameters by these scores within one frozenrun.
PeakCUDAallocated bytes and synchronized restorewallseconds per mode, fullallocatedGPU walltime, load/text/VAEprep costs separately.
Exactsame-input/seed repeat may be added as a reproducibility check but must be predeclared; absent such repeat, do not claim real tiled determinism from CPUfake tests.
not_covered: Whole original720x1280nativeframe operator memory/runtime and seams in bothaxes.
Unbounded fullvideo length performance; this is explicit17framecropQA.
